verdict.rationale: Honcho's core is open source and self-hostable, so you can keep your data on your own infrastructure in a standard Postgres database (honcho-docs-9, honcho-docs-10). The CLI also emits structured JSON for every command (honcho-docs-13), which together offer a route to owning and retrieving your data. However, the pack documents no dedicated export or bulk-download feature for the hosted service; the only migration doc covers importing from Mem0, not leaving Honcho. missing for 10: a documented full-data export (messages, peers, sessions, derived representations) in open formats, a hosted-service exit/offboarding path, and independent confirmation that data can be fully extracted.
